text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (Pseudotumor Cerebri). Given the confirmed papilledema and MRI findings showing increased intracranial pressure without a mass, this is the most likely diagnosis. I recommend starting with a trial of acetazolamide and scheduling a follow-up in two weeks to monitor your vision and headache frequency.
